criterion: which entity type the entity named at the end of the text ("The entity type of X") belongs to

categories.name: Person
categories.definition: Individual human beings, including historical figures, fictional characters, artists, athletes, and other named people.

categories.name: Location
categories.definition: Geographical entities such as countries, cities, towns, islands, bodies of water, mountains, and addresses.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: Groups of people formed for a shared purpose, including companies, political parties, government bodies, sports teams, and musical groups.

categories.name: Creative Work
categories.definition: Artistic and intellectual productions such as books, films, songs, albums, paintings, video games, and television shows.

categories.name: Event
categories.definition: Occurrences happening at a specific time and place, including battles, sports tournaments, competitions, and historical incidents.

categories.name: Product
categories.definition: Manufactured goods, vehicles, software, and other tangible items produced for use or sale.

categories.name: Biological Entity
categories.definition: Living organisms, biological structures, and medical or psychological conditions.

categories.name: Chemical Substance
categories.definition: Chemical elements, compounds, drugs, medications, and distinct molecular structures.

categories.name: Celestial Object
categories.definition: Natural objects in space such as stars, planets, moons, constellations, and galaxies.

categories.name: Language
categories.definition: Systems of communication used by a specific community or nation.

categories.name: Nationality or Demonym
categories.definition: Adjectives or nouns referring to the origin, citizenship, or ethnic identity of people from a specific location.

categories.name: Religion or Philosophy
categories.definition: Systems of faith, worship, or philosophical thought.

categories.name: Award or Honor
categories.definition: Distinctions, prizes, or decorations given in recognition of achievement.

categories.name: Legislation or Document
categories.definition: Written laws, acts, charters, treaties, and official manuscripts.

categories.name: Educational Institution
categories.definition: Schools, colleges, universities, and academic research centers.

categories.name: Transportation Infrastructure
categories.definition: Physical structures facilitating transportation, such as airports, bridges, highways, and railway lines.

categories.name: Currency
categories.definition: Systems of money and monetary symbols used in economic transactions.

categories.name: Scientific or Technical Concept
categories.definition: Theoretical constructs, programming languages, scientific classifications, and technical standards.
